operation.source_intent: ConfirmClickedAsync invokes only the supplied OnConfirm callback and fails closed while Busy or when the typed-confirmation contract does not match.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The shared Laravel confirm control mirrors AppConfirmDialog confirm guards, prevents duplicate dispatch, supports caller-provided typed-confirmation match state, and delegates only to the authoritative caller callback. The real Global Pages trash confirmation mounts the control and awaits its existing tenant-scoped WordPress mutation.

security_boundary.tenant_context: The Global Pages consumer remains bound to the authenticated active tenant and its existing tenant.context route.
security_boundary.authorization_test: GlobalPagesConfirmTrashTerminalityTest asserts a content.view-only user receives 403.
security_boundary.tenant_isolation_test: GlobalPagesConfirmTrashTerminalityTest asserts an editor cannot mutate the foreign beta tenant and receives 404.
security_boundary.authoritative_external_state: The existing Global Pages endpoint re-reads WordPress state before trash mutation and idempotently reconciles already-trashed pages.
